昼間に星が煌めいているのかと驚いてしまったよ。
text.official_en:
Why, if it isn't Miss Alexandra! How fare you? One
too rarely encounters a star twinkling in daytime.

まさしく輝くような美だ……！
text.official_en:
I can see how a radiant beauty such as you earned
the nickname "Silver Maiden."

Heh. How kind, Sirocco. But I got that name only as
leader of the Silver Knights of Tellus.
